intro: Lawyers build complex problem solving, judgment and negotiation skills that top executives and managers rely on daily. Of the 25 careers below, Chief Executives match lawyers best at 83%, with a BLS May 2025 median of $213,990.
why_it_works: Legal work means weighing risks, arguing a position and settling disputes under pressure. O*NET rates negotiation and persuasion at 4 out of 5 for lawyers, the same strengths that drive leadership, compliance and human resources roles. A general counsel already advises the executive team, which is why chief executive and compliance manager roles rank high. Policy and mediation roles use your reading of rules and people. The skills to add are mostly management ones, such as running budgets and staff.
tips: Start with in-house roles in compliance, contracts or HR, where a law degree is a strong selling point.
Build a track record of managing people or budgets, the skills most matches ask for that law practice rarely gives.
Keep your bar license active while you test a new path, so returning to practice stays easy.

faq.q: What can lawyers do instead of practicing law?
faq.a: The closest matches are Chief Executives (83%), Investment Fund Managers (78%) and Compliance Managers (78%), based on O*NET 31.0. Human Resources Managers and Industrial-Organizational Psychologists (77% each) are also close and use the same judgment and negotiation skills.

faq.q: Do any careers for lawyers pay more than law?
faq.a: Yes, but only a few. 5 of the 25 matches pay more than the $159,670 median for lawyers. Chief Executives earn a median of $213,990, a 34% increase, and Industrial-Organizational Psychologists earn $193,950 (+21%), according to BLS May 2025 data.

faq.q: Do lawyers need another degree to change careers?
faq.a: No for every option on this page: all 25 matches usually need no more education than a law degree, based on O*NET Job Zones. What many of them do need is management experience, since the top 10 matches often ask for skills in managing money and people.

faq.q: What jobs are closest to being a lawyer?
faq.a: Within the legal field, the nearest roles are Judges, Magistrate Judges, and Magistrates (92% match), Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers (84%) and Arbitrators, Mediators, and Conciliators (65%). Mediation lets lawyers keep working on disputes without going to court.
